lines.en: HELLO
WELCOME TO CHRISTMAS
Today is December 25th, 2020.
You have been here before on many occasions. But there is nothing particularly special about the second half of the date.
Today, you will be joined by three angels who will watch over you.
Their names are Malvin, Diamond, and Spork.
Malvin is a mischievous monk. He’s always sleeping in and stealing the laces from your left shoe.
Diamond is a good boy. You appreciate and relate to his impaired vision. But he is a spiteful monk, and will stop at nothing to get what he wants.
Spork is the youngest. A glutton, he is. But he has yet to learn right from wrong, so his advice should be taken with a grain of rice.
This song will play on repeat for the rest of the game. It is the only way to fix you.
Our records indicate that Akira Arakawa (You) is shouldering the great burden of childhood trauma.
To remedy this, we have hired a team of microscopic, invisible spelunkers to dive into the depths of his (Your) mind and retrieve relics of his (Your) past that may remind him (You) of brighter days.
Picture this — a tree. The tree belongs to Malvin.
He is your best friend. And he has convinced you to open your presents early.
So you tear into the first one with reckless abandon, mutilating the carefully arranged paper colored red and gold which serves as the skin.
It feels a bit like sex, you think. But you have only heard about that through the tongues of those who never come upstairs, so you’re not sure if you can take their words as gospel.
You look inside the box, now butchered. The box, not you. But what you find is no gift at all. It is a clock.
There are no hands on the clock — just thirteen numbers.
But what is this extra one?
You reach forward and touch it. Or at least you try to. Malvin suddenly has to leave.
: I suddenly have to leave!
: Why is that, Malvin?
: I have to feed Spork. A glutton, he is. And I don’t even want to think about what Diamond will put in his mouth if I’m late again.
: But it’s Christmas. Can’t you stay and find out what the thirteenth number does with me?
: Not now. But I’ll be right back to chauffeur you through this jolliest of days once dinner has been completed.
: I’m sorry, Akira! You will have to face the party on your own for now!
: But you’ve done it so many times before. Just act normal.
: AND DON’T LET THEM KNOW YOU TALK TO MONKS.
: Oh, good.
: It’s going to be one of those days, isn’t it?
: I think you’ll be fine, Sensei. That one only lasted for a minute or two.
: You don’t need a recap, do you?
A voice in your head that you put there because you were lonely reminds you to not let her know you talk to monks.
You spelunk into your own mind and manage to retrieve what she’s looking for.
: How many times did I cum inside of you today?
: Five.
: I think I need to go the hospital. I only remember four.
: I think you’ll be fine. And I’d offer to help you increase the count now, but we’re kind of short on time. The party’s already started.
: You look around to find that you’re at Tsukioka Manor. The grounds are filled with Christmas trees of the wrong color, indicating that the family possesses a lack of understanding of the holiday.
: Didn’t you have to go eat?
: Huh?
: Not you. Malvin. He’s a-
: Shhh! Don’t let her know you talk to monks!
: ...really great guy.
: Oh, crap.
: Ah! At long last, the two of you have finally shown up.
: Hi, Jeeves! And good evening to you, other rich girl!
: Tsukasa and I were just getting some air. The rest of the class is in the golden room right now.
: Do you remember how to get there, Sensei? Mother did show you the way, correct?
: Yeah. I think that’s the one she said that I’m supposed to marry you in.
: That...would be the room I am referring to, yes.
: You can always have me instead if you want, Jeeves! That way, we’d be able to have fun together every day! And I’d become part-poor person!
: Sorry, Tsukasa. Sensei has already agreed to marry me. But you can be the flower girl if you want!
: I respectfully decline your offer. Gardening is a peasant’s job. But I’ll see to it that your venue is properly taken care of if you’re married outside of the golden room.
: Please tell me you remember that she’s your responsibility from this point on? I’m at my wit’s end here and I’ve barely even spoken to Yasu today.
: Sorry, Touka. Unlike your mother, I don’t work holidays.
: Work? Mother isn’t working today. She’s at a romantic ski resort with Father right now.
: Shh!
Oh. Apparently this is supposed to be a secret.
That’s something I probably should have been informed of.
: ...Yes. I just mean that skiing is very hard work and that only the...most distinguished and talented of people can manage such a task.
: I never thought it was hard. Is skiing supposed to be difficult, Onee-sama?

: I believe Sensei is just being polite. One seldom forgets how to ski once they’ve learned. And even if it’s decades ago at this point, I’m sure he has fond memories of his time at...whatever ski resort the commoners use.
: My house is on a hill. Does that count?
: I’m not sure. I’d have to see it in the snow.
: We have a slope in the south wing of the manor if you want to practice, Jeeves! I’m sure one of the other Jeeves’ can find some equipment that fits you!
: An...excellent idea, Tsukasa! Buuuuut...wouldn’t you rather spend Christmas with the girls in my class this year? You were so adamant about coming, after all.
: I’m really only interested in Jeeves. Everyone else is kind of weird.
: And...And he isn’t? Besides, the south wing is miles away from here and-
: Skiing sounds fun and all, but I probably should see how everyone else is doing. They typically expect me to at least show up to gatherings like this.
: Plus, Ayane and I are already pretty late. For extremely reasonable...reasons, of course.
: There was...a lot of traffic on the way here. We only met up about an hour ago.
: Yeah. It would have been weirder to meet up early since Ami and Niki have been out of the house all day and I don’t like being alone with girls.
: Oh, Jeeves. Aren’t you a little too old to be getting nervous about things like that? I swear, it’s like you people become less and less advanced every time I encounter you.
: Meanwhile, I will elect to keep my mouth closed as my mind has matured to the point where I am able to pick up on context.
Ayane elbows me in the side and lets out a sigh. She’s probably upset that Touka was able to see through my expertly plotted ruse.
I elbow her back. She’s probably turned on now. It doesn’t take much for her.
: Ahem. At the risk of you two flirting any longer, allow me to show you the way to the party. Come, Tsukasa. And stay close.
: Yes, Onee-sama. Come, Jeeves! Come, other girl!
: We’ve had our interior decorators learn from the mistakes they made with my apartment to perfectly replicate a peasant Christmas! I’m sure you’ll find it to your liking.
: And I’m sure it will be nothing even remotely close.
: Oh. You know, I guess this is kind of close if you can look past this room itself being worth more than my house.
: Yeah, it reminds me a lot of the parties we have at my house. Just with less stuff.
: In all fairness, you seem to have what could only be referred to as an obscene amount of “stuff” at your mansion, Ayane.
: Yeah. I basically only use my money on Halloween decorations and guns.
: That’s like Onee-sama with horses.
: And you with stuffed animals.
: I like how everyone has just accepted Ayane’s addiction to firearms despite them being highly illegal in Japan.
: Me too. It keeps the police off my back.
: Jeeves, be on guard. There’s a small group of peasants attempting to swarm you.
: Yeah, that happens.
: Stop!
: Hey, who invited you guys?
: You did, Akira! We’re the manifestation of your ability to cope with your loss of innocence through the correlation of cartoon characters to much-needed distractions from reality!
: That’s so on the nose that I think I’m starting to suffocate.
: You were never good at breathing!
: Suffocation is precisely what all of this is! This endless smothering by indecision and a desire to get better, weighed down further by the hatred of who you are and what you’ve become!
: SPORK.
: Exactly! Which is precisely why you should throw yourself into perpetual uncertainty through camaraderie with this unending gallery of nubile flesh!
: That’s what I was trying to do before you interrupted me. Now, go away. I want to see who wins the party game this time.

: I just didn’t want you falling victim to one more scenario in which you encounter a presence you’re unsure of how to handle before tucking your tail between your legs and running off to hide in a public lavatory!
: It’s elementary, dear Watson.
: That’s not even the right thing, Diamond.
: SPORK.
: Ahem. Earth to Sensei?
: Is the music too loud in here for you? Because if Miku is okay, I assumed you would be as well.
: Hiya, Sensei! I live to see another day! But I ain’t gonna clarify what I mean by that since Noriko’s here too!
: Hey! Merry Christmas. I promise I didn’t bring anything this year that is going to make you sad and nostalgic. Apart from my existence, that is. But I kind of can’t exist without that, so...
: Hey, Noriko. Hey, Makoto. Please excuse me while I pick up Miku and claim her as my Secret Santa present for this year.
: Yeah, I had the same reaction.
: Damn, Makoto! You really were right about this dress bein’ the nail in Sensei’s coffin. But how’re you gonna be able to compete now that you’ve given me all this power?
: I’ll figure something out. But for now, I’ll take solace in the fact that I was, once again, able to accentuate your cuteness in a way that only a best friend could.
: You gonna let me give you a makeover next?
: I would sooner die.
: This isn’t everyone, is it? It looks like we’re still missing a few people.
: Don’t look at me. Touka’s in charge of this event. And for once in my life, I’m actually able to hold myself back from taking the reins as she is actually capable of doing such a thing.
: Otoha’s on the way. I just talked to her a few minutes ago. But Ami’s with Nee-chan, right? Is she gonna try and show up later or-
: Probably not. She’s felt kind of weird at parties ever since she stopped coming to school.
: Really? But that was only for a little while. And she’s seemed totally normal lately.
: Almost too normal. She barely even mentions you anymore.
: In all fairness, she barely even talks to anyone apart from Maya nowadays. But I think that’s mostly just because she still feels like we don’t accept her.
: Well, do you?
: Define “accept.”
: Ami’s kinda creepy, yeah. But love can make people act kinda weird, right? I ain’t got nothin’ against her. Even if she wants to do the naked disco with her uncle.
: I don’t know much about whatever this “naked disco” Miku is talking about is, but I’ve come to understand that I just...will literally never understand Ami.
: She’s great sometimes and terrible others. But she’s still like family at the end of the day — which means it doesn’t really matter how I feel about her.
: Well, regardless, she isn’t coming. And I think that’s what’s best for everyone.
: Say, have any of you seen Malvin around here?
: Pleeeeeeeease? I promise it only feels weird at first. After like five minutes, it’ll be amazing. I promise.

: Without knowing the context of what you’re suggesting, it sounds a lot like you’re trying to fuck me right now. Which would have been awesome like three years ago. Now, I’m just scared and mildly curious.
: Why do you...want Rin to dress up with you so badly anyway?...
: I just think it’d be fun! Like, at first, I was only doing this because I wanted Sensei to notice me. But now, I just genuinely think looking cute feels, like...totally freeing.
: And also because you still want Sensei to notice you.
: Yeah, but that’s just a given now. Don’t tell anyone I said that, Sana.
: I think...we all kind of know already...
: Does that...really help, though? Do you think he looks at you more when you...wear things like that?
: Mmm...
: Well, right now...no. But he’s busy right now. So of course he can’t focus on me and only me.
: Later, though? He totally will! And if he doesn’t, I just have to do something that’ll catch his eye! It’s like, totally easy! And even easier when you dress like this! Probably! Hahaha!
: Hah...
: You seem...kind of scary now, Chika...

: Why does everybody keep saying that? I’m like 1000%% normal and you guys keep acting like I’m turning into some creepy stalkery murdery girl or whatever. Is it the hair? Should I go back to blonde? Will that help?
: No, Chika. I think it’s the part where your voice is suddenly like two octaves higher than before. And how you keep giving everybody Noriko-eyes.
: Noriko-eyes? What the hell are Noriko-eyes?
: It’s when you open your eyes as wide as you can and smile so big that it hurts your cheeks. Like you’re really hamming up the whole “yandere” thing despite not actually being one at all.
: Even I can do it. I just try not to since I feel like I could get comfortable like this...
: Well, shit. That actually does look kind of creepy. Why is it normal for her, though?
: She’s probably just so nice that we’ve all learned to look past it by now. But it’s still weird when you do it since you’ve always seemed so chill.
: Now, every day it’s like you’re one step closer to snapping and gouging out somebody’s eyes. It’s, like...totally creepy. And the Santa costume makes it like five times creepier.
: So...fix my eyes. Got it. I can do that!
: Bringing your voice back down would help too, I think...
: Thanks, Sana. I’ll...
: Is there...a problem...Chika?...
: No, you just...
: You do look...really comfortable like that...
On the other end of the room, beyond the reach of Malvin, Ayane Amamiya had made her way over to the meat puppet.
: What do you want, Ayane?
But the meat puppet was currently mad because she wanted to have sex with Akira all day and didn’t get to due to extenuating circumstances including (but not limited to) Ayane’s vagina.
: I just wanted to see if you were okay. You’ve been really off ever since Halloween. And watching you just stand around all alone is making even me uncomfortable.
: Well, what else am I supposed to do? Ami isn’t here and neither were you and Sensei until a minute ago. The three of you are the only people I ever talk to.
: Well, I guess two of you now since getting Sensei to even look at me has been hard lately.
: Yeah...But that’s just because Sensei misses the other you.
: Yeah! But he won’t talk to me about that either! I even told him I’d be willing to try and learn! What else do I need to do?!
: All this...stuff keeps happening and I’m seriously trying to deal with it, but nothing is working!
: Like, what the fuck am I supposed to do to make things normal again, Ayane?! Am I gonna have to fuck Ami for the rest of my life?!
: What?...What would that-

: It’s a...figure of speech, okay?! I just have no idea how I’m supposed to compete with Niki! And I thought I could compete with you, but apparently you’re also getting screwed like fifty times a day now!
: And don’t even say you’re not because I snuck in today and I know what I heard.
: I’m sorry you had to hear that, Maya. But...maybe you’d have better luck reaching him if you stopped leaning into the...sexual aspect of it all?

: I mean...that’s obviously not the only part I care about. But that’s the part that always reaches him. He gets all...depressing whenever we actually talk. And I do too. So, like...what do I do, Ayane?
: Are you actually asking me for help?
: Yes. I am desperate at this point. And the time for rationality has apparently been tossed out of the window, so I’m willing to try anything now. And I seriously mean anything.
: It feels weird seeing you so...helpless.
: I know. “The old Maya was always strong and confident and blah, blah, blah.” I am clearly not her. I may never be her.
: But if what you’ve told me is true, the one thing she and I do have in common is that we both want the same thing. And it feels fucking weird when I am the one standing in the way of that.
: You’d really try anything?
: Yes. But I swear to god, if you ask me to lure him back with a threesome as well and then the world starts repeatedly breaking until the two of us are making out, I’m just going to kill myself.
: What? No. I don’t want to make out with you.
: Not yet, you don’t. It’s only a matter of time, though. ‘Tis the season, Ayane. You’ll feel left out just like me soon enough.
: Maya...look at me.
: You know I want to help you. I practically need you if I’m ever going to get to the bottom of this...timeline stuff. But I think you’re overestimating just what I can do here.
: I love Sensei. Everyone knows that. But the connection you two have runs way deeper than I’m able to reach. That’s been obvious ever since I figured it out. And I don’t...
: I don’t want to hurt him, Maya. Nor do I want to risk winding up in the same predicament you have because it gives me one more thing to claw through on the way to some kind of ending.

: And...I’m sure you two will find your way back to one another eventually. Without my help. Which, frankly, wouldn’t be all that helpful in the first place as I exist in a part of his world that you don’t.
: So, basically, you’re telling me to go fuck myself.
: I wouldn’t word it that harshly, but...I guess, in a way, I am.
: It’s not because I want you to fail, though. I’m just...adapting the same strategy with you that I have with Sensei.

: I will support you with all of my heart and all of my soul...but if I just keep dragging you guys where you want to end up, you’ll never figure out how to get there on your own. Do you know what I mean?
: Yeah. You mean you want me to fuck myself. Message received.
: Maya...
: Time to go find a bathroom so no one has to see me do it in public, I guess. Later, Ayane. Thanks for nothing.
: Hah...
: The two of them really were made for each other, weren’t they?...
